title: ZeGA: Zero-Gradient Gated Adaptation via Weight-Space Synapse Cartridges
read_level: full (10-page PDF text); figures not inspected
metadata_mismatch: Concept DOI 24168084 resolves to version record 24168085 (version 'v1 preprint'). Title, author and date match the paper.
why_wsp: Closed-form (SVD / ridge / polarization identity) synthesis of appended gated MLP channels from forward-pass calibration activations, with no gradient optimizer and no LLM editor; explicitly framed as extending WSP (Takehi et al.) to reversible cartridges.
domain: Swedish-language LLM adaptation, CLIP compositional binding, SDXL localized image editing
editor: none (solver): closed-form SVD / ridge regression / Theorem 3 polarization construction
target: Ministral-3-8B-Instruct-2512-BF16 (8,918,026,240 params); CLIP-ViT-B/32 (151,277,313 params); Juggernaut XL SDXL UNet (2.57B)
loop: one-shot (SDXL: "scalar offset/gain tuned on 1 development scene")
fraction_or_count_of_weights_changed: base weights untouched; appended "+8/14,336 channels in L32 and +32/14,336 in L33" (Ministral), "+56/3,072 channels in visual L10" (CLIP), "+8/5,120 channels across 15 GEGLU blocks" (SDXL)

baselines_and_controls: Unedited base models; constant post-norm steering (Symmetric-150: 54.67%); 1-row and 2-row CLIP controls vs 4-row quartet; constant-gate control for SDXL. No LoRA/DoRA or ROME/MEMIT runs (compared only conceptually in Table 1).
runs_and_variance: single run / not reported; exact McNemar tests on paired items
robustness_of_edits: Detach restores base exactly ("100.0000% full-byte SHA-256 restoration"); preservation suites (Belebele, Anchor-40, Python-20, Math-20, CIFAR-100, CelebA); not tested under fine-tuning or quantization.
verification: SHA-256 audits of base weights; string-overlap audits between calibration and evaluation sets; proofs of Theorem 3 polarization identities (real arithmetic)
limitations_stated: Corollary 1 bounds single-block residuals only; Family II doubles row count; SpatialRel Group Score stays below the 16.67% reference; CLIP suites are synthetic rather than Winoground/SugarCrepe; audio, video, trained diffusion adapter comparisons and Family III left to future work.
cites_or_builds_on: Takehi, Teoh, Zhang, Khattab 2026, Sparks of Weight-Space Programming (blog; Experiment 8)
notes_for_survey: Gradient-free, LLM-free closed-form construction of detachable gated channels across text, vision-language and diffusion models, positioned as an extension of WSP; relevant to B5 as a non-LLM editor. No AI-authorship statement found.
